global_caveat: This is a candidate set, not a complete denominator. ARM9 instruction ownership remains unresolved; BL-site and caller-CFG evidence can still include data false positives.

review_findings.boundary_support: Each selected leaf starts at a decoded ARM BL immediate destination, has a complete linear extent through BX LR, contains no PC-relative literal access or internal branch/call, and has no incoming decoded BL target into its interior. All selected extents are non-overlapping.
review_findings.caller_evidence: One caller per row is confirmed in a saved prologue-rooted local CFG with that direct BL instruction and normal return site(s). Other raw caller sites were not individually CFG-checked.
review_findings.false_positive_risk: No full ARM9 code/data map exists. Whole-image decoding segmented around undecodable spans can decode data as instructions; plausible CFG shape lowers this risk but does not remove it.
review_findings.aliases_and_clones: No same-address aliases. Exact identical-body groups are recorded below; they are separate addresses and are not asserted to be aliases.
review_findings.undefined_behavior: Most memory candidates need exact owner/layout, alignment, bounds and alias contracts. Use fixed-width unsigned arithmetic for shifts/wraparound until signedness is established. arm9:0201a994 has an abs-like signed-negation hazard at INT_MIN; fixed-base address candidates need platform-region semantics before source typing.
